prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1310; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was diagnosed with concussion. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are consistent with the head trauma described. Over the course of care, the patient attended 29 visits. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury, with symptom management, graded activity guidance, and vestibular and cognitive rehabilitation provided as needed. Imaging and serial neurological examinations clearly confirm the diagnosis. The patient reports no prior injury to the head or neck, and none is documented in available records. Billing for services has been reviewed and reflects single, appropriately recorded charges for each encounter. At the most recent evaluation, the patient was improving, with remaining symptoms being monitored and a plan for gradual return to usual activities.
